## Questions to answer

These were the questions brought up in the 1/8 discussion:

- Was there a relationship between budget and box office?
- How have the production budgets have changed over time?
- Are certain genres more prevalent over time?
- Is there a relationship between the rating of a film and box office?
- What is the relationship between production cost and rating?
- What is the relationship between critic ratings and film genre?
- The number of infamous people associated with each film vs. critic rating

::: {.callout-note}
Are all of these real questions?
:::

Let's apply Munzner's framework to all of them and build an "instance" (or more) for each one:

- [What? (data the user sees)]{.red}
- [Why? (the task the user is performing )]{.yellow}
- [How? (the methods)]{.green}
